headline: 57th IFFI Opens in Goa
summary: The 57th International Film Festival of India has officially opened in Goa to celebrate diverse global cinema and storytelling traditions.

headline: Goa Aims to Become Film Hub
summary: Chief Minister Sawant stated at IFFI that Goa aims to transition from merely being a shooting location to a complete film production hub.

headline: IFFI Opens with 'Stories without Borders'
summary: The festival commenced with the 'Stories without Borders' theme, featuring a musical tribute to world cinema led by Ricky Kej.

headline: Calangute Fire Destroys Shacks
summary: A fire in Calangute gutted four beach shacks completely, though no injuries were reported. Authorities have announced financial compensation for the affected operators.

headline: Anywhere Registration System Gains Traction
summary: Goa Chief Minister highlighted that over 300 citizens have benefited from the newly implemented Anywhere Registration System.

headline: Mapusa Sub Registrar Office Renovated
summary: Goa's Chief Minister inaugurated the newly renovated and modernized Sub Registrar's Office in Mapusa city.

headline: Goa Approves AI Policy 2026
summary: The Goa cabinet has approved the AI Policy 2026, earmarking Rs 50 crore toward skilling graduates and rolling out technology labs across educational institutions.

headline: Mandrem and Galgibaga Gain Blue Flag Status
summary: Mandrem and Galgibaga have become Goa's first beaches to receive the prestigious Blue Flag certification, joining 22 other beaches across India.

headline: Tiger Survey Cameras Stolen
summary: Two tiger survey cameras were reported stolen from a wildlife sanctuary in Goa.

headline: Curchorem STP Challenged in PIL
summary: A Public Interest Litigation has been filed challenging the Curchorem Sewage Treatment Plant, alleging that mangroves were destroyed during the process.

headline: ACB Raids Suspended Constable's Bungalow
summary: The Anti-Corruption Bureau and Directorate of Vigilance conducted searches at the residence of a suspended police constable in Valpoi.

headline: Tiger Sighting Renews Sanctuary Calls
summary: A recent tiger sighting in the Mhadei basin, the first in two years, has renewed local calls for establishing a tiger reserve.

headline: Worker Dies in Assagao Shop Fire
summary: A 19-year-old worker succumbed to 90% burn injuries following a fire at a shop in Assagao.

headline: Monsoon Deficit Causes Crop Loss
summary: A monsoon deficit in Goa resulted in Rs 18.7 lakh worth of crop losses, with Sanquelim being the hardest hit area.

headline: Zuari Bridge Twin Towers Work to Begin
summary: Construction on the twin towers of the Zuari bridge is scheduled to begin this month and is expected to be completed in 2.5 years.
